title: Li/Keiper coefficients lambda_n and Li's criterion

methods.zero_sum: lambda_n = 4 sum_{gamma<=gamma_N} sin^2(n arctan(1/(2 gamma))) + integral tail from T_eff (N_smooth(T_eff) = N) against (1/2pi) log(u/2pi) du; error bound sup|S| * TV(f) with Trudgian's |S(T)| <= 0.112 log T + 0.278 log log T + 2.510
methods.arb: lambda_n = n [z^n] log xi(1/(1-z)) via arb_series (deflated zeta, lgamma, log, composition); rigorous ball enclosures

theory.c0_note: S_1(n) = (n/2)(H_n - 1 - log 2pi) + 1/2 + exp. small = (n/2)(log n + gamma - 1 - log 2pi) + 3/4 - 1/(24n) + O(n^-3)

oscillating_part.definition: lambda_n - [(n/2)(H_n - 1 - log 2pi) + 1/2]  (= S_2(n) up to < 1e-9 for n >= 50)
